name: myosin XVIIIA

function.text: MYO18A encodes putative TGFB1-induced anti-apoptotic factor 1. It participates in canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction and negative regulation of apoptotic process.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.
